reference.title: X-ray diffraction and equation of state of solid neon to 110 GPa

methods.scope: Stress-condition check. The source says neon was unsuitable for accurate calibration and excluded bridged-sample data with multi-GPa disagreement.

recalculation.notes: Tables 2-3 preserve every row-wise Au lattice parameter and temperature, and gold_anderson_1989_bm3_1 is executable. Recalculation with its density-derived rounded V0=67.79 A3 gives pressures 0.13-0.26 GPa below the printed values; the table is reproduced to 0.017 GPa RMSE if the effective Au V0 is fitted as 67.8454 A3.

pressure_calibration.notes: The final article explicitly states that only gold pressures were used for its perovskite EOS; that main pressure axis is linked to an executable record. Ruby and neon served as checks. The overall status remains partial because row-wise ruby and neon readings are not printed and the rounded Anderson reference volume does not exactly regenerate the tabulated pressures.

assessment.basis: Every compared free coefficient meets both the recorded combined-two-sigma comparison and parameter-specific numerical similarity screen. Error conventions and fit qualifications remain applicable.
qualifications: Direct final-article reproduction. Mao et al. explicitly fitted only the Fe10 data with K0-prime fixed at 4; Table 1 supplies the fixed Fe10 V0=162.79 A3. The paper does not state weights, and unweighted pressure residuals recover K0=260.80 GPa from the rounded table. MgSiO3 and Fe20 inherit this indistinguishable compression curve with their separately measured composition-specific ambient volumes.

fit.selection: fit_included=1: all nine 300 K Fe10 rows in final-article Table 2

primary_source_check.finding: Table 1 supplies the three composition-specific V0 values. The fit paragraph explicitly selects the Fe10 data and reports K0=261(4) GPa with K0'=4; Tables 2-3 provide the final gold-pressure observations.

primary_data_check.diagnostic_dataset_scope: Authoritative 12-row precursor table retained to document the changed pressure reduction and fit scope.
primary_data_check.finding: All 16 final room-temperature rows are transcribed. The source selects the nine Fe10 rows; with V0=162.79 A3 and K0'=4 fixed, an unweighted pressure-residual fit gives K0=260.80 GPa and reproduces the reported 261(4) GPa.

parameter_provenance.determination_method: Measurements or their experimental reduction determine this EOS; source: Final article abstract and journal pages 8071-8074; Final article Tables 1-3; Final article equation-of-state fit paragraph and Figure 4.
parameter_provenance.equation: The final 298 K isotherms use a Birch equation with K0'=4 fixed; Peritheos stores the algebraically identical BM3 special case.
parameter_provenance.parameters: Final-publication Table 1 gives V0=163.53(10) A3 for Fe20; the room-temperature fit paragraph gives K0=261(4) GPa with K0'=4.
parameter_provenance.fit_scope: The shared elastic coefficient was fitted only to the nine 300 K Fe10 rows in Table 2. The MgSiO3 and Fe20 rows demonstrate indistinguishable compression, while their Table 1 V0 values remain composition specific.

superseded_record_text.notes: BM2 is represented as BM3 with V0 and K0_prime fixed, which is algebraically identical. The final article fits K0 only to Fe10 data and applies the indistinguishable compression curve to all three composition-specific ambient volumes.
